# moshlabs_context (Data Source)

Resolves the platform/account/environment/service context for the calling scope: cascades metadata and builds the labels map, exactly as modules/system-context does, but as a single data source read instead of nested module calls.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright 2026 Mosh Labs
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

# Platform scope — the top of the hierarchy.
data "moshlabs_context" "platform" {
  platform = "core"
  metadata = {
    organization  = "acme.com"
    status        = "ACTIVE"
    control_plane = "core"
  }
}

# Account scope — receives the platform's resolved context via `init`
# instead of re-deriving it.
data "moshlabs_context" "account" {
  init    = data.moshlabs_context.platform
  account = "acme"
  metadata = {
    ecosystem = "production"
    cloud     = "gcp"
  }
}

# Environment scope — receives the account's resolved context via `init`.
data "moshlabs_context" "environment" {
  init        = data.moshlabs_context.account
  environment = "prod"
  metadata = {
    region = "us-east1"
  }
}

# Service scope — receives the environment's resolved context via `init`.
data "moshlabs_context" "service" {
  init    = data.moshlabs_context.environment
  service = "api"
  metadata = {
    version = "1.2.3"
  }
}

output "service_scope" {
  value = data.moshlabs_context.service.scope # => "service"
}

output "service_labels" {
  value = data.moshlabs_context.service.labels
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `account` (String) Account name. Leave unset to resolve a platform-scoped context.
- `environment` (String) Environment name. Requires account to be set (directly or via init). Leave unset to resolve an account-scoped context.
- `init` (Attributes) The already-resolved context of the parent scope (e.g. the output of a `moshlabs_context` data source one level up). Fields set directly (platform/account/environment/service/metadata) take precedence over the matching init field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--init))
- `metadata` (Dynamic) Metadata for this scope, merged over init.metadata. Accepts any shape (matching system-context's permissive `any`-typed metadata argument) — only the keys declared by each resolved scope are kept (platform: organization/status/control_plane, all required; account: +ecosystem (required)/cloud/region; environment: +region; service: +version); everything else is silently dropped, same as the HCL module's per-scope object() type coercion. The resolved value is a flat string map in which declared-but-unset keys are present as null.
- `platform` (String) Platform name. Required, directly or via init — this is the top of the hierarchy.
- `service` (String) Service name. Requires environment to be set (directly or via init) — a service always belongs to an environment.

### Read-Only

- `labels` (Map of String) Cloud-resource-label-safe key/values accumulated across the scope cascade (lowercased, underscores->dashes in keys, dots->dashes in values).
- `scope` (String) The deepest resolved scope: "platform", "account", "environment", or "service".

<a id="nestedatt--init"></a>
### Nested Schema for `init`

Optional:

- `account` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `platform` (String)
- `service` (String)
